NAT.title: Numerical Answer Type (NAT)
NAT.rule: NAT carries 32 risk-free marks (21.3% of Part A). Because inputs are numerical without multiple-choice anchors, off-by-one counting errors forfeit credit. Verify spatial counting and fold axes twice; never leave unattempted.

MSQ.title: Multiple Select Questions (MSQ)
MSQ.rule: Asymmetric Expected Value (EV): Selecting only verified options guarantees +1/+2/+3 marks with zero penalty risk. Speculating on a 50% subjective probability option yields EV = 0.5(+4) + 0.5(−1) = +1.5m — LOWER than guaranteed +2.0 partial score. Never speculate unless probability of correctness > 67%!

MCQ.title: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)
MCQ.rule: Because penalty ratio is only 1:6, eliminating 1 distractor turns random-guess EV to (1/3)(+3) + (2/3)(−0.5) = +0.67m. Eliminating 2 distractors sends 50/50 EV to +1.25m per question! Aggressively eliminate two implausible choices and commit.

sketching.desc: Adherence to specified camera POV, eye-level/worm's-eye/bird's-eye horizon line and vanishing points.
Anatomical proportion, lively gesture, foreshortening, and authentic facial emotion.
Line-weight hierarchy (bold foreground, medium midground, light background), tonal contrast & directional light.
Contextual accuracy of surroundings, material textures, and credible spatial scale.

creativity.desc: Avoiding 1st-thought clichés; surprising lateral leap in narrative or concept.
Seamless, organic integration of assigned symbol/fragment without geometric distortion.
Clear narrative progression, humour, rhythm, and unexpected twist across frames.
High-contrast black-ink rendering, clean composition, and witty conceptual titling.

visual_sensitivity.desc: Uniform stroke weight, corner radius, and degree of abstraction across all 4 icons/glyphs.
Instant readability of meaning at first glance with zero textual labels inside boundaries.
Equilibrium between positive black ink and negative white space inside the bounding box.
Precision of edges, pristine geometric control, and uniform solid black fill.

form_sensitivity.desc: Preserving core geometric proportion, silhouette character, and formal integrity of the inspiration form.
Harmonious integration of operational features (handles, nozzles, joints, controls) into the sculptural body.
Believable 3D volumetric rendering, highlight lines, core shadows, and surface texture.
Authentic depiction of parting lines, material transitions, and refined ergonomic touchpoints.

problem_id.desc: Identification of subtle, high-friction, unarticulated stakeholder pain points rather than generic issues.
Structured 'How Might We' framing with clear causality and socio-technical context.
Novel, feasible, and user-centric design interventions directly solving the stated problems.
Clear annotated diagrams, exploded callouts, user-flow cues, and legible explanatory notes.
